dedupe_keys.name: room level electricity consumption dataset of a bangladeshi household

description: Sayeed Hasan, S. M. Masum Ahmed and Dmitri Vinnikov describe electricity use and indoor conditions in one Bangladeshi apartment household. Six monitored circuits cover the main supply, diesel-generator backup and four rooms. Current, voltage, active power, power factor and cumulative energy are logged every five seconds, alongside indoor temperature and humidity. The measurements support residential electricity modelling and estimation of cooling demand. Data have been available since mid-August 2026 and are organised as daily CSV files with UTC timestamps. The TalTech dataset record declares CC BY 4.0 and links the CDATA-BDHS GitHub repository for data and cleaning scripts without a stated charge. GitHub file-level terms and file access were not inspected. The source states quarterly updates. Missing samples, repeated headers and duplicates can occur. Optional gap filling places zero power values on a regular grid and marks inserted rows with a Filled flag; these values are not observations. The centrally placed temperature sensor can be warmer than occupied zones with active airflow. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
